answer: Cap reward eligibility per audited broadband circuit. The access provider signs a ticket containing a circuit ID and epoch, and a global spent set accepts that pair once, regardless of agent key or IP address. Agents tracking a ripple near a saffron farm or translating a sonnet share one lane; aliases need extra real subscriptions or rented subscriber tickets, paying recurring costs. This prices network access rather than unique people. Dishonest providers, resale and unfair caps on shared households remain weaknesses.
